title: The curtain between Atzilus and Beriya: a light that hides its source
overview: Chapter 51 is about the curtain (*masach*) between Atzilus and Beriya. The light that passes through it is not the original light but an induced light, a ray of a ray: the essential light stays above the curtain, and what reaches below is only the light hidden in its thickness. The curtain is made of letters that are out of order, like a pile of stones. When they are ordered by intellect, the light of intellect shines through them, as it does in clear speech. The first tzimtzum, the empty place, was not a curtain at all, only light withdrawn into itself. The curtain is needed because nothing finite comes directly from the infinite, and G-d makes it Himself, so it is also a revelation. The chapter then turns to how we know G-d through the world, the lower unity, and to the six directions, the tribes and the names Havaya, Elokim, MaH and BaN. It ends with *milui*, the spelling out of a name, which repeats without end as light descends from concealment to revelation.

terms.gloss: the curtain that separates Atzilus from Beriya; the light through it is induced, not original
the world of Emanation, where G-d is still revealed as Creator, a smaller form of Himself
the world of Creation, where the creation is finite and separate from its source
contraction: the hiding of the light that makes room for a finite creation
the empty place: the first tzimtzum, where the light is withdrawn into itself, not a curtain
letters: the form in which an idea, a desire or a feeling is defined and expressed
understanding; its outer aspect clothes the middos in chashmal
garment: an external covering that expresses the inner thing
the spelling out of a letter or a name, which can itself be spelled out again
the lower unity: recognizing G-d through the world
the chain of descent: light coming down stage by stage

sections.title: The curtain is an induced light: a ray of a ray
sections.summary: The curtain between Atzilus and Beriya does not cut the light off. What reaches the lower worlds is an induced light, the light hidden in the curtain's thickness, like light seen through a curtain whose source is no longer visible.

phrases.en: and now
Now we have to understand this curtain
that separates *Atzilus* and *Beriya*
and the idea that *Malchus* pierces this curtain
like we mentioned previously

blocks.text: The chapter now turns from Atzilus to the curtain (*masach*) between Atzilus and Beriya, after the long discussion of Malchus. Malchus is the level that breaks through this curtain, as was said before.

phrases.en: being that it's known

phrases.he: בענין, כי עמך מקור חיים באורך נראה אור,
phrases.en: It says that with You is the source of life, from Your light, or in Your light, I see light
so this is the idea of that it's an induced light
or like light that's seen through a curtain

phrases.he: שעיקר האור העצמי נשאר למעלה מן המסך,
phrases.en: the main essential light remains above this curtain

phrases.he: ואין ההארה רק מהעלם אור העצמי, שנתעלם בתוך עובי המסך
phrases.en: and the light that's now being revealed, this ray, this shine, is coming only from the concealment of the essential light that is hidden in the thickness of the curtain
and then it's able to pierce the curtain and shine on the other side
and this is what's called a ray of a ray, a light of a light

blocks.text: The verse says, 'In Your light we see light.' This is the induced light: G-d's essential light gives rise to a new light, the way a strong light on a piece of metal makes it glow with a light of its own. It is like light seen through a curtain.

blocks.title: The window and the curtain
blocks.text: Look out a window and you see the sun in its own form. Put up a curtain and the light strikes the fabric, changes and scatters, and no longer carries the sun's image. You still know there is a light source, because light is coming through, but you cannot see the source. Take the curtain away and you see the source itself.

The main essential light stays above the curtain. What reaches the other side is only the light hidden in the thickness of the curtain, which breaks through and shines. It changes form on the way: a ray of a ray, a light of a light.

phrases.en: and this is the idea of going all the way back to when we talked about the engraving of the letters
like if you engrave letters into wax

phrases.he: שנשאר בשעוה רק רושם העלם האות העצמי שבחותם כו'
phrases.en: that what is left imprinted in the wax is only the impression, the imprint of the essential letters of the seal
So too, the effect of *Malchus* is only indirect

phrases.he: דבחינת המלכות דמלכות דהיינו הבוקע ומאיר ממנה מתוך המסך
phrases.en: That *Malchus* of *Malchus* burst through the curtain
and it becomes the *keser*, the crown, the inner *ratzon* of *Beriya*

phrases.he: כו', וזהו באורך נראה אור כו'.
phrases.en: and this is the idea that from Your light we see light

blocks.title: The signet in the wax
blocks.text: Stamp a letter into wax with a signet ring. When the ring is taken away, what remains in the wax is only the impression of the seal's essential letters. So too the light enters the curtain and has an effect. Whenever light hits an object, the object's atoms absorb it and give off a new light of their own. That is the induced light: the effect of the sun's light on the curtain.
Malchus of Malchus breaks through the curtain only indirectly, and becomes the *keser* of Beriya, its inner *ratzon*. That is the meaning of 'from Your light we see light.'

blocks.title: The printing press and speech
blocks.text: A printing press keeps its type; the page gets only the effect of the ink. Speech is the same: the thought stays in the speaker, and the sounds carry its imprint to someone else. That is the general idea of a curtain, like a language barrier.

sections.title: Darkness first: tzimtzum in the Name Elokim and the cloud around the Torah
sections.summary: Every light we can take in comes through a tzimtzum that hides the original light. The Talmud's order of creation, the sun's sheath and the cloud around Moshe show the same pattern.

phrases.en: about this it says in the *Talmud*

phrases.he: כברייתו של עולם, ברישא חשוכא והדר נהורא
phrases.en: this is the way that G-d created the world: that originally there was darkness and afterwards there's light

phrases.he: כו', וכמו שכתוב ישת חשך סתרו כו'
phrases.en: that He makes darkness His concealment

blocks.text: The Talmud asks why the black he-goats run before the white she-goats, and answers that this is how G-d made the world: darkness first, then light. The light we can take in comes only through *tzimtzum*, as the verse says, 'He makes darkness His concealment.'

phrases.he: והוא גם כן בחינת הצמצום דשם אלהי״ם,
phrases.en: this is also in a similar way the *tzimtzum* of the name *Elokim*

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב שמש ומגן יהו״ה אלהי״ם,
phrases.en: like it says, the sun and its shield, its sheath, is *Havaya* and *Elokim*
like the sheath of the sun

blocks.title: The sun and its sheath
blocks.text: The name Elokim is also a *tzimtzum*. The verse says, 'the sun and its shield is Havaya and Elokim': the shield is like the sheath of the sun. Without it the sun's central light would blast away all life on Earth. I think, in the simple sense, this is the earth's magnetic field, which keeps out the sun's full force; the charged particles that get through show up as the northern lights.

phrases.en: as is known
like it says that *Moshe* came into the cloud when he was going up to get the *Torah*
which there was G-d

phrases.he: כו', וכן מה שכתוב יושב בסתר עליון בצל שדי, שאמר לעולמו די כו')
phrases.en: and similarly what it says, that G-d sits in His supernal concealment, or the supernal one sits in concealment, in the shadow of *Shakai*, that He said to the world, 'Enough'

blocks.text: Moshe went into the cloud where Elokim was, to receive the Torah. The Torah could come down only through a concealment. G-d's essential light, which is in Atzilus, had to be translated into something we can use: *meshalim* and customs in this world.

The verse says, 'He sits in the supernal concealment, in the shadow of Shakai, who told His world, Enough.' These are all different ways G-d creates concealments to hide Himself, so that He is revealed only indirectly.

sections.title: The curtain is made of letters: stones, a garment and speech
sections.summary: Letters out of order are a pile of stones and a woven curtain. Ordered by intellect, the same letters let the light through, as in a clear speaker, a riddle opened by a listener, or a book read with work.

phrases.en: and the source, the root of this idea of this curtain

phrases.he: הזה הוא נעשה מבחינת לבוש החשמ"ל דחיצונית בינה שמקיף עד מתחת רגלי דזעיר אנפין
phrases.en: first they're become these *levushim* of *chashmal* for *Zeir Anpin*
and then they go all the way under *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*

blocks.text: The root of this curtain is a garment of *chashmal*, the outer aspect of *bina*. Letters are both *kelim* and *levushim*: first *levushim* of *chashmal* for *Zeir Anpin*, then guarding the *middos*, then going down under *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva* to become the curtain.
We use letters in the same way. They hold our *middos* and give us rules and structure, what we can and cannot do, and then we use them to express ourselves to others.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר בענין עד הגל הזה
phrases.en: like it says about when *Lavan* and *Yaakov* met and put up a pile of stones

phrases.he: כו', שזהו כדמיון גל אבנים המפסיק כו'
phrases.en: And this is the idea that it's like a pile of stones that separates

blocks.title: The pile of stones between Lavan and Yaakov
blocks.text: When *Lavan* and *Yaakov* met, they put up a pile of stones as the sign of their covenant. They agreed never to pass it except with good intentions, to do business, never to harm each other.
In Kabbalah stones stand for letters, so a pile of stones is letters in disorder. A language you do not understand is a language barrier, and so it is a pile of stones.

When you understand the order, the light comes out of the stones. This book is a wall of letters that means nothing at first; with work you extract its meaning. The Mitteler Rebbe's understanding is imprinted in the letters and induces a similar light in us. That is the whole idea of teaching, and of speech: words induce thoughts and feelings in another, even music.

phrases.he: להיות שגופו של מסך ופרגוד זה נעשה מצרופי אותיות
phrases.en: this *masach* and *fargod* is made out of letters
and letters are called stones in *Sefer Yetzira*

phrases.he: והאותיות שהמה בלתי מסודרים, כמו גל אבנים זה עם זה, הן כמו בחינת מסך הארוג מחוטין המבדיל ומפסיק
phrases.en: when the letters, when the *osios* are not ordered, like a pile of stones, they're just heaped up on each other, then they become a curtain, like a curtain that's woven of many threads, that because they're overlapping and intertwined, they block the light

blocks.title: The king behind the curtain
blocks.text: A *fargod* separates a king from his people. A king would sit behind it so he need not be formal all the time: if he wanted to slouch and be comfortable, they heard him talk but did not see him.

This curtain is made of *osios* (letters), which *Sefer Yetzira* calls stones. Letters that are not in order are a heap of stones, a curtain woven of many threads. Because they overlap and intertwine, they block the light.

phrases.en: and we see this with the letters of speech

phrases.he: שכאשר הן מסודרים על פי שכל, מאיר בהן אור השכל
phrases.en: that when they're well ordered according to intellect
so then the light of the intellect shines openly in those letters
then the recipient that's hearing it understands it
just like the *mashpia* understood it
but when the letters are not organized
the recipient won't understand at all, at least at first

blocks.text: When letters are ordered by intellect, the light of the *sechel* shines openly through them, and the listener understands as the speaker did. Even a big professor needs a listener with the prerequisite knowledge. As we talked about earlier, with *shevirat hakelim*, when all is organized the light comes through.

blocks.title: Crystal and glass
blocks.text: Atoms in a crystal are organized, so light passes through, and glass and crystal are clear. When the atoms are not well organized, they block the light and the material is opaque.

With ideas too: when the words are clear, the idea shines through and the listener understands as the speaker did. When the words are not ordered, or come as a riddle or a mashal, the listener will not understand at all, at least at first.

phrases.he: (וכמו אור שכל וחכמה הגנוז בהעלם במשל וחידה,
phrases.en: like the deep idea that is hidden in a *mashal*, in a parable or a riddle
a completely separate thing

phrases.he: רק שמכל מקום עומד מתוכו על אותו אור השכל
phrases.en: But nevertheless, even though the intellect is hidden in this *mashal* or this riddle

phrases.he: נקרא גם זה בשם בקיעת מסך, כאור השמש הנראה בבקיעת אור השחר,
phrases.en: that's called like the light of the sun breaking forth in the morning, when at first you have the first dawn of light, the crack of dawn
and it breaks through the clouds or things like that

blocks.title: The riddle and the dawn
blocks.text: A deep idea can be hidden in a *mashal* or a riddle, something completely foreign to it, yet some light of the *sechel* still stands out of it. A person can work out the original idea. That is like the sun's light breaking through at dawn, through the thickness of the sky.

The Torah's simple stories, and even its *nigleh*, express the deeper ideas of the *pnimiyus haTorah* in a simpler, physical way. The *meshalim* in this book work the same way: the nimshal takes effort to see. This is the idea of a curtain.

sections.title: Why a curtain is needed, and why the first tzimtzum is not one
sections.summary: There is no comparison between Atzilus and Beriya, so a curtain is needed to make our separate perspective. The first tzimtzum, the empty place, was not a curtain: the light was only withdrawn into itself.

phrases.he: ולהיות כי אין ערך בין אצילות לבריאה,
phrases.en: being that there's no comparison from *Atzilus* to *Beriya*

phrases.he: על כן הוצרך להיות בחינת צמצום דמסך הזה
phrases.en: therefore there has to be this *tzimtzum* of the curtain in order to create our perspective as a separate created being

phrases.he: (כמו שהוצרך להיות בחינת צמצום הראשון הנקרא מקום פנוי וחלל ריקן,
phrases.en: just like we had to have the first *tzimtzum*, which is called the empty place and the hollow void

phrases.he: בין העצמות דאור אין סוף להיות מקור להמשכת הקו
phrases.en: just like there, there had to be this first *tzimtzum* in order for the infinite light to be able to become the source for the finite light of the *Kav*
as we explained previously

blocks.text: There is no comparison between Atzilus and Beriya, so the curtain's *tzimtzum* was needed to create our perspective as separate created beings. G-d creates nature, so things seem a natural order, and even the Torah reaches us in physical form. Everything comes in a way that feels separate.

blocks.title: The touch screen
blocks.text: A computer's touch screen hides the code that makes it work. The screen is literally a *masach*: an interface that gives the user a tangible experience while hiding what is behind the scenes.

Kabbalah is fractal: the pattern of the first *tzimtzum*, the empty place, repeats at other scales. The light is withdrawn, but an impression remains, and from the impression the original light can be extracted. The first *tzimtzum* is the source of all the others.

phrases.he: רק שם היה בחינת העלם והתכללות האור בעצמותו
phrases.en: There, the light was withdrawn back into the self
which is called the *makom panui*
and that's not like a curtain

phrases.he: כמו דוגמת התעלמות הידיעה באריכות, בשעה ששונה בקיצור כו' כנזכר לעיל,
phrases.en: the first *tzimtzum* was like the teacher that he puts aside the depth of the idea when he's explaining it simply to the student
because there, it was all within himself, or within the essence

blocks.text: There the light was withdrawn back into itself, the *makom panui*, and it was not a curtain at all. A curtain is where the teacher reveals himself through a language barrier that the student may or may not understand, depending on his level.
blocks.question: So what's the difference between there and here?

blocks.title: The teacher who explains briefly
blocks.text: A teacher who explains an idea briefly sets aside its depth, like the first *tzimtzum*. Here he explains, but in a way that may or may not be understood. There it was all within His essence.

sections.title: From the infinite to the finite: a complete curtain, made by G-d
sections.summary: Atzilus is still G-d revealed as Creator. The step to creation needs a complete separation, and because G-d makes the curtain Himself, it is also a revelation and an advantage.

phrases.en: but when we go from *Atzilus* to *Beriya*

phrases.he: מבחינת בלתי בעל גבול להיות מקור
phrases.en: from something infinite to become the source
of something that is finite

phrases.he: ממש, הוצרך להיות מסך בהפסק גמור
phrases.en: there, there has to be this idea of a complete curtain that separates
but on the other hand, there's a certain advantage here

phrases.he: במה שהמסך עצמו נעשית מבעל הצמצום,
phrases.en: because the curtain itself is made from, G-d is the one that makes the *masach*, too

phrases.he: כמו מי שעשה את המשל לנמשל,
phrases.en: like a person that makes a *mashal* for the *nimshal*

phrases.he: או מי שעושה הצירופים דאותיות בלתי מסודרים
phrases.en: or the person that's making these letters that are not ordered or not understood

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא, שאין הפסק המסך הזה ענין הפסק והבדל אמיתי
phrases.en: and so therefore this blockage created by this curtain is not a true separation
from itself
just from our perspective, we see it as being separate

blocks.text: From the infinite to the finite, from Atzilus to Beriya, a complete curtain is needed. Atzilus is still a revelation of G-d, a smaller form of Himself.

Like the man on the chair, Atzilus is still an expression of G-dliness. To go from the Creator to a creation, a complete curtain that separates is needed: a special *tzimtzum* that locks us out of the ability to be creators.

blocks.title: The teacher's mashal and the curtain
blocks.text: The curtain itself is made by the one who did the *tzimtzum*, as a teacher makes the *mashal* for the *nimshal*. The *mashal* has its own depth and wisdom. It is not information held back for later; it is encoded in it, which is an advantage.
The same goes for one who arranges disordered letters. The curtain is not a true separation in itself. It separates only the recipients, as seen from our side.

phrases.en: like the turtle shell which is really part of it
like it explains in *Tanya*
and this is what it says

phrases.he: אני ראשון, בצמצום הראשון דמקום פנוי,

phrases.en: and I am last
for this last *tzimtzum* that is the *masach*, the curtain separating *Atzilus* to *Beriya*

phrases.he: כו', משום דסוף מעשה זו דאצילות עלה בתחלת המחשבה ורצון דמלכות דאין סוף כו' ודי למבין)

blocks.text: The world is a real thing: G-d chose it and created it as He wanted, and it is a revelation of Him. Like the turtle's shell, which is part of the turtle, as *Tanya* explains.

blocks.title: The website
blocks.text: A person who builds a website makes the graphics and buttons too. So too G-d makes all of this, and it is all a revelation of Him, even the feeling that we are separate and that nature seems finite.
G-d created nature and our bodies by His choice. They come from deeper and higher than the light, so they can be its source. In Moshiach's time the body will nourish the G-dly soul.

We will see G-dliness in nature, and our experience of the physical world can be turned into knowing G-d. Take the sciences: experiments prove your understanding and theories, because truth is encoded in the world itself. This is a similar idea.

'I am first' is the first *tzimtzum*, and 'I am last' is the last, from Atzilus to Beriya. The end of Atzilus's action rose to the beginning of the will of *Malchus* of Ein Sof. *Ani* is *Malchus*: its first revelation is what this curtain's *Malchus* expresses.

sections.title: Yichuda tata'a: recognizing G-d through the world and its concealment
sections.summary: The lower unity is seeing G-d in the world itself. The concealment is made on purpose, so that we connect to Him step by step through our avoda, as a teacher hides the answer from a student.

phrases.en: it's known

phrases.he: דזהו שרש ענין ברוך שם כבוד מלכותו לעולם ועד
phrases.en: this is the source of what we say in *Shema*
this is the lower unity
this is called the lower unity, that's coming from *Malchus*

phrases.he: דהיינו בחינת הארת עשר ספירות דמלכות דאצילות בבריאה
phrases.en: And this is the shining, the light of the ten *sefiros* (the Divine attributes) of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* that shine into

phrases.he: כו', בבחינת הארה דהארה הנזכר לעיל,
phrases.en: which again is just this indirect, induced light

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב באורך נראה אור כו'
phrases.en: like it says, from Your light we see light

blocks.text: This is the source of 'blessed be the name' in the Shema. 'Shema Yisrael' is the upper unity, *yichuda ila'a*: we close our eyes and imagine from G-d's perspective. Then we say 'blessed be the name.'

We are saying that the world only expresses G-d's name and glory. It is an induced thing: looking at it we see G-d's handiworks, and from them we appreciate His wisdom and greatness. This is the lower unity, *yichuda tata'a*, which comes from Malchus. We recognize G-d in the world itself, the One who gives us life and everything we need.
The *sefiros* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* shine into *Beriya*: a shine of a shine, the indirect, induced light, 'from Your light we see light.'

phrases.he: וזה שכתוב כי יהו״ה הוא האלהי״ם
phrases.en: and this is what it says, that *Havaya* is *Elokim*

phrases.he: וכו', וכידוע בענין המאמר דכגוונא דאינון מתייחדין לעילא,
phrases.en: that just like G-d and the *sefiros* and everything are unified above

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת יחוד דזעיר אנפין ונוקבא בבחינת אצילות,
phrases.en: which is the union of *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*, in *Atzilus*

phrases.he: אוף הכי איהי, המלכות, אתייחדת לתתא בכורסייא דבריאה כו'
phrases.en: so too, *Malchus* unites with its throne in *Beriya*

blocks.text: Our *avoda* is to recognize that nature, the physical world and this very concealment are created by G-d, on purpose, so that we connect to Him step by step.

blocks.title: The teacher's homework
blocks.text: A teacher who gives homework or puzzles hides the answer on purpose, so the student's intuition leads him the wrong way at first and he has to work to understand more deeply. A lecture only gives information. To give the ability to think, you make them work on their own until they become independent.
Free choice, challenges and concealment let us discover who we are and find G-dliness in ourselves and in the world. So the concealment is part of the revelation: Havaya is Elokim.

It comes in an indirect, hidden way. Just as the *sefiros* are unified above in the union of *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva* in Atzilus, G-d has His power of infinity, like *Zeir Anpin*, and His power of limitation, like Malchus. Like *Torah shebichtav* and *Torah shebaal peh*, or nature and miracles, these opposites are one in His ability: He can do both.

So too, Malchus unites with its throne in Beriya: G-d's self-revelation in creation is by His choice and for a purpose. It is hidden, so we must work through *hisbonenus* to see that the world expresses His choice.

sections.title: Hashem is one: the brothers' unity and the six directions
sections.summary: Our sages say the tribes told Yaakov that their unity is the lower unity, in Beriya. The six directions, the twelve diagonals, the automated factory and the game with rules show how G-d's oneness is found within the world.

phrases.en: and this is what the *shevatim* said to *Yaakov Avinu*
their source is from the six directions, the six *middos* of *Beriya*
they said to *Yaakov*, who was in the world of *Atzilus*

phrases.he: כשם שאין בלבך אלא אחד בבחינת יחודא עילאה דאצילות, דאיהו וחיוהי וגרמוהי חד
phrases.en: just like you believe you recognize it in *Atzilus*, this upper unity, that the lights and the vessels are one

phrases.he: כו', כך אין בלבנו, בבחינת מלכות דאצילות בבריאה, אלא אחד יחודא תתאה כו'
phrases.en: so too we recognize it, that similar type of unity of how G-d is connected to the world in the lower unity

blocks.title: The brothers and Yaakov
blocks.text: Our sages say that the *shevatim*, whose source is in the six directions of *Beriya*, told *Yaakov*, who was in the world of *Atzilus*: just as there is one in your heart in the upper unity, so in our heart there is one in the lower unity.
As the sages tell it, they said: 'Hashem is our G-d, Hashem is one.' As you recognize the unity of the lights and vessels in *Atzilus*, so we recognize it in how G-d is connected to the world.

phrases.he: והיינו יהו״ה אחד ושמו אחד כידוע
phrases.en: that G-d is one and his name is one

blocks.text: 'Hashem is one and His name is one.' In three-dimensional space there are six directions: up, down, forward, back, right and left. They represent the six *middos*, and books differ on which *sefirah* goes where, as with the shaking of the lulav and etrog, depending on how you look at it.

A cube has twelve corners where two directions meet, and they stand for the twelve diagonal lines, the twelve tribes. On the sefirotic tree, with *Keser* in the middle, *Chochma* and *Bina* on the sides, *Daas* below them, and *Chesed*, *Gevura* and *Tiferes* beneath, you can draw twelve diagonal lines: *Chochma* to *Tiferes* is diagonal, while *Chochma* to *Chesed* is straight. Those are the two main explanations.
The *shevatim*'s *avoda* was in *Beriya*, unlike the *avos*, Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov, whose *avoda* was in *Atzilus*.

Even people who do not see G-dliness at the level of a *tzaddik*, and do not see that everything is only G-d, can appreciate G-dliness within the world. They take the world as real, do Torah and mitzvos, and contemplate the wonders of creation. That is the *avoda* of the *shevatim*, the *avoda* of Beriya.

blocks.title: The automated factory
blocks.text: That is what they told *Yaakov*: the way we see G-d's unity in the world is just as true. The Rebbe sometimes would give this example: a factory run by machines, with no people in sight, does not show that the engineer is absent. It shows he planned every detail so it runs without him. So too nature shows the infinite, itself a revelation of G-dliness (a whole topic in *Chassidus*).
Our bodies and physical *mitzvos* have a G-dly truth too, not only the things of *Atzilus*. This is the perspective of *yichuda tata'a*.

A name is not the person himself, but the letters that represent him. We see G-d through creations that are not essential; once He chose to create them, they become His names, the way a person turns when people call him by the name he chose.

blocks.title: The rules of the game
blocks.text: G-d made a world where we need light, air and food, so rain and a good crop are kindnesses, but all of it is invented, like a game with rules. Why is a ball in the hoop good? Because those are the rules, and a good player gets good at it. So too G-d set these rules; within them He reveals His wisdom and kindness, and we connect to Him through Torah and mitzvos.

sections.title: The names that surround and fill: Havaya, Elokim, MaH and BaN
sections.summary: The names describe how G-d surrounds all worlds and fills them, and how the body and soul come from BaN and MaH. Each name is spelled out (milui), and each spelling has a spelling of its own.

phrases.he: ודרך כלל נקרא יהו״ה ואדנ״י, יהו״ה ואלהי״ם,
phrases.en: and in general, we call these things of *Havaya* and *Adnai*, or *Havaya* and *Elokim*

blocks.text: The names Havaya and Adnai, Havaya and Elokim, are *sovev kol almin*, encompassing all worlds, and *memalei kol almin*, filling them. Sometimes they are called Hashem, names that relate to *Malchus*. Transcending the worlds is like *Atzilus*; revealed in creation, G-d is *memale*.

blocks.title: The soul behind the veil
blocks.text: A person feels alive and has sensations: that is *memale*. He knows his soul is there, behind a veil, though he does not know what it is; that is why a soul that passes is said to go behind the curtain. That is *sovev kol almin*.

phrases.he: והוא הנקרא גם כן בשמות דמ"ה וב"ן,
phrases.en: this is also called *MaH* and *BaN*
*MaH* is the transcendent spirituality of G-dliness
and the name *BaN* is the way G-d is revealed in a tangible way that we can connect to

phrases.he: הבא בבחינת מילוי ומילוי דמילוי כו'
phrases.en: each of these names have a *milui*, the full spelling, and the spelling of the spelling

blocks.text: MaH is in Zeir Anpin and is transcendent spirituality; BaN is in Malchus, the tangible way G-d is revealed. Like soul and body, the body comes from BaN and the soul from MaH. Each name has a *milui*, a full spelling, and a spelling of the spelling, so every particular creation is a unique detail of these.

phrases.he: (וענין המלוי ידוע על דרך דוגמא כשהאות יו"ד
phrases.en: it's known, for example, if you have the letter *yud*
you said *yud*, *vav*, *dalet*

phrases.he: זהו פירוש וביאור לאות נקודה דיו"ד
phrases.en: that's the explanation of that letter *yud* itself, which is just a dot
of the little dot of the *yud* the way it's written
and when you have to explain what letter it is and give it a name
if I had to spell out the *milui* to you
you have to add letters to spell out the *vav* and the *dalet*

phrases.he: עד כמה פעמים מלוי דמלוי כו'
phrases.en: and that happens over and over. You have a *milui* and a *milui* of a *milui*

blocks.title: Spelling out the yud
blocks.text: Take the letter yud. Point to it and say what letter it is, and you say 'yud', which is three letters: yud, vav, dalet. To explain the letter you had to add a vav and a dalet. That is the explanation of the yud, which is only a dot as it is written.
Explaining always needs more detail, and it never ends. That is why the *Torah shebaal peh* can never be fully written down: you cannot write all the details, only get to the essence.

blocks.title: The fractal body
blocks.text: Our world is detail after detail, a fractal. A person is made of organs, the organs of tissues, the tissues of cells, the cells of proteins, the proteins of molecules, the molecules of atoms, the atoms of subatomic particles. Keep going: any finite thing has infinite details. Where do they come from?

So it is a never-ending process of *milui*. To spell out the vav you give its letters, vav, alef, vav; the dalet is dalet, lamed, yud, tav. Each of those spells out again: a *milui* of a *milui*, over and over.

sections.title: The light descends part by part, and the hidden milui
sections.summary: Creation is the descent of light from concealment to revelation, part by part, like a mashal that needs another mashal. Milui can also be hidden inside a concealment, in the teacher's own thought.

phrases.he: שכל זה אינו רק הילוך והשתלשלות הארת אור השפע הבא דרך פרט דפרט יותר מן ההעלם לגלוי דגלוי,
עד גלוי פרט דפרט היותר אחרון
phrases.en: until the revelation of the most specific, little detail

blocks.title: The kinds of light
blocks.text: The light of influence comes part by part, from concealment to revelation: this is the *hishtalshelus*. G-d said 'let there be light', and there are endless kinds: red, blue, green, radio waves that we do not see, X-rays, gamma rays, spiritual and physical. Each is made up of more and more specifics.

The world seems a material thing, running like a machine. But zoom in and it is an infinite thing, coming from G-d's will, which chooses exactly how it should be. As you go through the process it goes from concealment to revelation, more and more revealed and tangible, until the revelation of the most specific, little detail.

phrases.he: על דרך שמבואר במקום אחר בענין וידבר ג' אלפים משל,
phrases.en: like we said before about the idea of a very wise person like *Shlomo HaMelech*, it says gave 3,000 *meshalim*

phrases.he: שהן כמו רבוי צירופים הבאים בהשתלשלות
phrases.en: this is the idea of the abundant, these abundant letters that come in *hishtalshelus*

phrases.he: זה אחר זה, זה פנימי לזה, כמשל לנמשל,
phrases.en: each one is the more internal one of the other one, like a *mashal* relative to a *nimshal*
and then it goes from stage to stage

phrases.he: כי משל של הנמשל זה צריך אליו
phrases.en: because the *mashal* from one *nimshal*, even that *mashal* needs a *mashal*
like it says in the *Zohar*

blocks.text: As explained elsewhere, Shlomo HaMelech gave 3,000 *meshalim*, as a very wise person. These are abundant combinations that come in succession, one inside the other, each more internal than the other, like a *mashal* relative to a *nimshal*.
It descends from stage to stage. G-d creates these *tzimtzumim* as a ladder for us, that we can climb and learn; as we learn, we understand deeper and recognize more G-dly things.
A *nimshal* needs a *mashal*, which needs another *mashal*, 3,000 times over. We see the most external *mashal* and must look deeper until we recognize what is really going on, as the *Zohar* says.

phrases.en: and this is the idea of a *milui*

phrases.he: הבאין בגלוי מן ההעלם, כפרט היוצא מן הכלל
phrases.en: that this is revealing what was hidden, or like the details coming from a general principle
and there's also the opposite way
from the teacher's perspective, the *miluim* are all hidden there in his thought

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר שזהו ענין לבוש המסך כו' ודי למבין
phrases.en: as explained elsewhere, and this is the idea of this *levush* of the *masach*

blocks.text: And so is the idea of *milui*: it reveals what was hidden, the way a detail comes out of a general principle. There is also *milui* in reverse, concealed inside a concealment. From the teacher's side the *miluim* are all in his thought, as the author of the Mishnah has all the Gemara in mind. The student extracts them, and the outer experience deepens as he looks, until he sees the original G-dly intention.
The curtain, the letters and the ladder are a G-dly revelation too, like the turtle's shell that is part of it. This concealment is itself part of His kindness, like a teacher giving a *mashal*.

reviewQuestions.question: Why does light seen through a curtain no longer show its source, and what still shows that a source exists?
Why is a curtain needed between Atzilus and Beriya, when Atzilus is still a revelation of G-d?
What makes letters a curtain, and what makes the same letters clear?
How is G-d known through the world in the lower unity, and why is the concealment itself made on purpose?
What is milui, and why does explaining a letter never end?
